1.1. A new gender-responsive poverty and inequality metrics and tools in measuring multidimensional poverty, adjusted to the local context has been designed and piloted based on household budget survey (HBS) for 2021. 1.2. The enhanced sex and age disaggregated poverty-related data analyses and monitoring have been piloted in November 2022 based on HBS data to improve improve policymaking and effective policy implementation. The pilot showcased how systematized analysis and reporting of non-monetary deprivations at the national level could be utilized. The analysis of MPI based on 10,000 households data has been conducted. 1.3. In order to build capacity to integrate multidimensionality angle into national policy discourse by cultivating the community of practice on multidimensional poverty and inequality, two participants of Center for Economic Research and Reforms (CERR) and Institute of Forecasting and Macroeconomic Research (IFMR) took part in summer training course on Multidimensional Poverty, which was conducted by OPHI from 1 to 13 August in Indonesia.
